theme: Causal event exchange bridge: time, volume, relativistic propagation and gauge curvature
status: Mathematically verified controls and one sharp false-step falsifier; NO TOE
prior_art: Johnston (2008), Particle propagators on discrete spacetime, arXiv:0806.3083
Surya (2019), The causal set approach to quantum gravity, Living Reviews in Relativity
Path sums for propagators in causal sets, Phys Rev D 109 046008 (2024)
Gauge Fields in Causal Set Theory (Sverdlov/Bombelli et al.)
Link-based causal set propagators in 1+1 dimensions, Phys Rev D (2026)
new_to_repository_calculations: Constructive analytic 1+1 constant-E charged KG Green radial ODE with Wilson transport
Poisson falling-factorial unbiased event-count estimator for charged radial amplitude
Exact flat U1 finite-chain gauge covariance and nonzero Wilson-loop holonomy
PDE witness that gauge covariance alone fails to supply field-curvature tail

Myrheim_Meyer_dimension_control.meaning: Dimension estimation assumes the sample was sprinkled in a preselected Minkowski dimension; does not dynamically select 3+1 dimensions.

mass_and_proper_time_from_causal_chains.ensemble_identity: E[(C^(k+1))_ab]=(rho V)^k/(k!)², V=tau²/2. Hence E[K_ab]=J0(m tau)/2 at every positive density rho.
limitations: Johnston's causal-set retarded free scalar propagator is known prior art.
The ensemble expectation is exact on the Poisson Minkowski background; a finite realization has stochastic noise.
Sprinkling assumes the continuum Lorentzian volume and dimension, not a dynamical derivation.
The retarded Green function is not a physical full quantum-state Feynman propagator.
Asymptotic chain height does not yield a coordinate-free metric at finite density without calibration.

exact_constant_E_charged_KG_and_Poisson_.field: constant background electric field E in 1+1 Minkowski; A_x=E t, A_t=0, qE dimension mass²
exact_constant_E_charged_KG_and_Poisson_.charged_exact_retarded_kernel_inside_con: G_R(t,x;0,0) = [1/2] exp(i qE t x/2) f(t²-x²); f solves 4(s f''+f')+[m²+(qE)²s/4]f=0, f(0)=1
exact_constant_E_charged_KG_and_Poisson_.derivation: D_t=partial_t, D_x=partial_x-i q E t; using straight-line U=exp(i qE t x/2), covariant wave operator reduces to stated ODE
exact_constant_E_charged_KG_and_Poisson_.mathematical_unbiasedness: For N~Poisson(rho V), E[(N)_n]=(rho V)^n; replacing s^n=(2V)^n by (2/rho)^n(N)_n in exact radial power series gives unbiased ensemble kernel at ANY rho, assuming known m,E and continuum background.
important_limits: This uses continuum minimally coupled charged Klein-Gordon dynamics as input, not its derivation from order alone.
The Poisson count estimator assumes the background diamond volume and density are given, and the constant electric field is external.
A bare event count determines volume only statistically; it does not produce a general curved spacetime metric.
No claim to derive charge, coupling, gauge group, matter spin, interactions, or quantum gravity.

gauge_covariance_vs_dynamical_failure.conclusion: Gauge covariance of edge phases is NOT sufficient for correct dynamics in nonzero curvature. The bare m=0 Wilson-edge causal sum misses a known exact J0(qE*s/4) tail.
gauge_covariance_vs_dynamical_failure.scope: External constant electric field in fixed 1+1 flat spacetime; no derivation of full nonabelian gauge dynamics, Born rule or quantum gravity.

four_dimensional_null_cone_link_distribu.physical_distinction: 2D massless scalar propagates throughout the light cone, while 4D massless retarded scalar is supported on the null cone. Full 2D causal relation matrix C cannot replace dimension-sensitive 4D near-null link L.
limitations: Known causal-set link propagator scaling from Johnston and review papers, not new physics.
External 3+1 flat Minkowski geometry and Poisson density are assumed.
This weak distribution test does not recover arbitrary matter, 4D spinor chirality or quantum gravity dynamics.
